verdict.rationale: Audit logging of flag changes is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers creating, updating, scheduling and managing flags via the UI, API, CLI and MCP, but nothing documents an audit or activity log recording who changed a flag, when, and to which value.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value
